name.description: The new Manager's name, its title from the start.

face.description: The face it wears: a character and a color, and one emoji in the character's place if you like; left out, one is picked.

repositories.description: The GitHub repositories it works in, as owner/name, the first its checkout; left out, your own.

model.description: The model it runs on, by its catalog id, as list_models lists it; left out with effort, the asking member's default.

effort.description: The reasoning effort, as the model lists it; given with the model or not at all.

message.description: A first message handed to it from you, which opens its first turn; left out, it waits for the member's first words.
